g.text: 1. All grounds are common and return to BMS P- (splice G, P14, XT30, P8). B- and P- are separate nodes on the Tenergy board: nothing but the cell goes on B- [L].

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 2. Power on: XT30 in, panel switch ON. The 2815 slide switch stays OFF so the panel switch (between SW and GND) controls it. Not an emergency cutoff (Pololu): unplug the XT30.

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 3. Battery: Tenergy cuts at 2.40 V per cell, below the P30B 2.5 V minimum: stop in software at servo Present Voltage about 6.0 V (about 3.3 V per cell loaded).

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 4. D15: servo power bypasses the adapter (BEC -> SPV/SPG -> SP1 SP2 SP3). Adapter H1 NOT connected; its 3.3 V logic runs from USB VBUS. Bench check: it must enumerate and drive the bus with H1 unpowered.

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 5. Program U1 to 7.2 V with Castle Link V4 through its Link Port (2-wire jumper, U1 at 5 V or more) and measure before connecting servos. Check U3 = 5 V with no load first.

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 6. Solder 16 AWG into the 2815 large holes (Pololu: use them above 5 A). U3 EN and PG stay open. Pins 9 and 20 take 3 x 26 AWG each: twist and tin first [I].

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 7. BMS pads (Tenergy image): B-, B1 (mid tap, to the holder series strap), B+, P-, P+, T (NTC output, left open [I]). Pin 6 holds the U3 ground, so the SG90s and amp return on pin 14 [I].

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 8. D17 (7:24 PM ET): foot switches Omron SS-01 gold contacts (min. load 5 VDC 1 mA), SS-10 fallback (5 VDC 160 mA); the feet feed the policy, so R4, R5 2.2 kOhm pull-ups give about 1.5 mA.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle
